description:
the solstone app for windows

the solstone app for windows takes in what you share with it from your screen, system audio, and any microphone you choose. it prepares local, owner-controlled segments for your journal. the solstone app runs on windows; your journal lives on a computer you own. no telemetry.
Added
- importing a HEIC or HEIF photo through the solstone app on windows now converts it to JPEG on your PC while keeping the date it was taken and its orientation, so your journal can accept it. if your PC can't convert a photo, the app says so and doesn't add it to your journal.
Fixed
- right after you connected to your journal on this PC with every source off, the last setup step said "paired with". it now says "connected to".
